upstream.title: Supplier integration
upstream.siteAddressExtra: Enter the HTTPS root URL of the supplier site. Do not append /api/v1/upstream.
upstream.merchantKeySaved: Saved credential: {masked}. Leave blank to keep the current value.
upstream.merchantKeyPlaceholder: Enter the Dujiao-Next API Key; leave blank to keep the saved value.
upstream.secretSaved: The secret is encrypted and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the current secret.
upstream.secretExtra: Dujiao-Next API Secret. It is encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM.
upstream.secretPlaceholder: Enter the API Secret; leave blank to keep the saved value.
upstream.clearCredentials: Clear the saved API Key and API Secret
upstream.pricingFormula: Final price = supplier SKU price × exchange rate to USDT × (1 + percentage) + fixed markup. Fixed markup is in 0.01 USDT units; prices are rounded to cents.
upstream.exchangeRate: Supplier currency to USDT exchange rate
upstream.exchangeRateExtra: Enter how many USDT one unit of the supplier currency is worth. For example, use 7.20 for CNY. USDT is always treated as 1. Sync is blocked when a non-USDT currency has no configured rate.
upstream.batchSizeExtra: Process 20–50 supplier products per page; default is 25.
upstream.batchDelayExtra: Pause 250–10,000 ms after each batch; default is 1,000.
upstream.enableRules: Save credentials and complete one successful sync before enabling. While supplier sales are enabled, site, credentials, and pricing cannot be changed. Disable and clear the supplier catalog before changing settings, then sync again before re-enabling. When enabled, bots show only the supplier catalog. Disabling switches back to local products, then removes supplier catalog data and unreferenced images. Historical orders and financial records are retained.
upstream.callbackExtra: Enter this site's public HTTPS URL. The path must be /api/v1/upstream/callback. The supplier will send completion callbacks; polling remains as a fallback.
upstream.lowBalance: Alert when supplier balance falls below
upstream.lowBalanceExtra: Use the supplier account's own currency. Set to 0 to disable the low-balance threshold alert.
upstream.disableConfirm: This deletes all supplier categories, products, SKUs, and supplier images no longer referenced by local products. Historical orders and financial records are retained. This action cannot be undone. Continue?
upstream.resolveNotice: Verify the local order number in the supplier portal first. Do not assume the supplier rejected an order just because local polling timed out. This decision determines whether status polling resumes or retry/refund becomes available.
upstream.notAccepted: Supplier confirms not accepted / definitively failed
upstream.externalIdPlaceholder: Enter the numeric order ID returned by the supplier
upstream.evidencePlaceholder: e.g. supplier portal lookup result or support confirmation
upstream.refundTitle: Confirm refund for failed supplier procurement
upstream.refundNotice: The local order amount will be credited to the customer's store balance, with a separate refund ledger entry and administrator audit record.
upstream.refundReasonPlaceholder: Explain why fulfillment is confirmed to be impossible
upstream.autoSync: Automatic sync runs at the interval above. A failed sync preserves the last successful catalog.
